text:
tomas: Heads-up: Lumen-XL 13B quant landed in the catalog candidate bucket. Want to discuss onboarding gates and pin policy before we expose to any tenants.
keisha: Nice. We should treat this as an experimental entry with strict benchmark requirements. Any initial perf numbers?
priya: Early numbers from bench infra: gen p50 ~85ms on A100, p95 ~210ms; embedding similarity delta vs benchmark model is ~2.3% drop on the semantic bench. Cost per 1M tokens is ~9% lower.
rod: 2.3% embed drop may matter for retrieval-heavy tenants. Can we run a retrieval-specific eval on the tenant cohort?
tomas: Agreed. Proposal: 3 gates for catalog entry -> (1) bench pass on generic eval suite, (2) tenant-sample bench within X% drift, (3) migration opt-in form + pin policy.
keisha: For pin policy I'd prefer: default = "ephemeral-experiment" (no pin), opt-in pin window = 30 days, catalog flag `pin_tier: experimental`, and a deprecation warning TTL of 14 days once we mark it GA.
priya: For retrieval tenants, add a stricter gate: embedding similarity >= 97.5% vs their baseline on their sample prompts. If below, require customer opt-in to accept embeddings change or use a compatibility shim (reranker pass).
rod: How do we surface the opt-in? A small UI checkbox + signed addendum? Sales will need messaging. Also tracking tag `onboard: lumen-13b-candidate` in catalog metadata.
tomas: I'll add the catalog metadata. Also need telemetry: route-level rollout tags and a metric `embed_regression_pct` for customers.
ops-bot: bench-run queued: model=lumen-xl-13b-q, config=quant8, eval-suite=general+retrieval, notify=#product when done.
keisha: Launch criteria suggestion:
- generic eval pass rate >= 99% on unit tests
- embedding similarity >= 97.5% for retrieval tenants or explicit opt-in
- p95 latency <= baseline + 25ms
- no perf regression >5% on long tail prompts
priya: Also add cost guardrail: cost delta <= 12% per 1M tokens; otherwise label as "cost-advantage" but require ops signoff.
rod: For pinning: if a tenant requests a pin, we offer: short pin (30 days) on Dedicated/Durable plans only; otherwise recommend opt-in + audit log + grace rollback script.
keisha: Need a rollback runbook: maintain a hot-standby binary for any pinned tenant for the pin duration; automated revert on metric breach. Keep pin_count limited to avoid capacity strain.
ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/catalog/pin-rollback-lumen-13b.md (internal).
legal: We'll need a small addendum template for customers who request a pin that covers credits and SLA differences. I'll draft and share.
priya: One more ask: add a small canary cohort (5 tenants) that get early access with telemetry opt-in; customer-facing comms should include a short prompt set and expected QA checklist.
tomas: OK. Action items:
- priya: schedule tenant-sample retrieval bench + post results here (ETA 48h)
- keisha: draft catalog entry metadata + pin policy language + comm blurb
- rod: coordinate sales messaging and opt-in form with legal (ETA 24h)
- tomas: create tracking tags and reserve a canary cohort slot
- ops-bot: keep canary bench running and alert on embed_regression_pct > 2%
keisha: If any objections to the 30d pin + embed gate, say now. Otherwise I'll proceed with the catalog PR draft. :party_parrot:
rod: No objections from me. We should tighten capacity alerts though.
tomas: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the tenant benches come back.
ops-bot: bench results: general eval pass=99.4%, retrieval-sample (tenant A)=97.3% similarity, (tenant B)=98.1%, (tenant C)=96.9%.
